notes.title: Blow it up is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are thrilled to announce that Blow it up is now out and ready to play! If you have any suggestions and feedback head to the forums and let us know your thoughts.

Launch Trailer
[previewyoutube=lpOc9duVdO4;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is also available on Xbox One|X|S, Playstation 5 NOW!
Its also coming on Switch, IOS and Android on 27th of February.

Thank you for being part of our journey!
